get.summary: List the workspace's registered agents (Admin only).

post.summary: Register an agent and mint its token (returned once).

201.description: The created agent, plus its bearer token (shown only here).

get.summary: List the OAuth agents the signed-in user authorized to act on their behalf.
List an artifact's collaborators (collaborators only).

200.description: The workspace default role and the artifact's members.

put.summary: Share an artifact with a person at a role.

delete.summary: Remove a collaborator from an artifact.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's follows in their active workspace.

200.description: The caller's follows. People-follows carry the followed person's public handle/name/avatar.

post.summary: Follow a GitHub author, a repo path prefix, or a person.

get.summary: List the active workspace's collections (members only).

200.description: The workspace's collections, each with its item count and origin.

post.summary: Create a collection.

put.summary: Add an artifact to a collection.

delete.summary: Remove an artifact from a collection.

get.summary: List a collection's members.

200.description: The collection's creator and its members.

put.summary: Add or update a collection member.

get.summary: Slack connection status for the signed-in user's workspace.

200.description: Whether Slack is available + connected, and the team + default channel.

patch.summary: Set the channel Derive posts to (Admin only).

200.description: The new default channel (or null to clear it).

delete.summary: Disconnect Slack from the workspace (Admin only).

post.summary: Report an artifact for abuse (public).

get.summary: The open moderation queue (Admin only).
The moderation audit log (Admin only).

post.summary: Take an artifact down (Admin only); its content 410s everywhere.
Reverse an artifact takedown (Admin only).
Dismiss a report without taking the artifact down (Admin only).
Propose a candidate version (multipart, like publish).

201.description: The created proposal, plus the thread ids it marked addressed.

get.summary: List an artifact's proposals (optionally filtered by state).
One proposal, with a line diff against its base version.

post.summary: Approve a proposal (its content goes live as a new version).

200.description: The approved proposal + the version number it became.

post.summary: Request changes on a proposal (it stays open for revision).
Withdraw an open proposal (proposer or a manager).
Send back a review with the human's answers.
Approve a review (the go-signal).

get.summary: List an artifact's review rounds and the pending one, if any.

200.description: All rounds (newest first) and the current pending round or null.

post.summary: Post a comment (new thread) or a reply (with thread_id).

get.summary: List an artifact's comments (authenticated readers only).

200.description: The artifact's comments, each flagged whether its anchor still resolves.

post.summary: Resolve or reopen the thread a comment belongs to.
Toggle a reaction on a comment.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a comment (author only); the row stays, body tombstoned.

post.summary: Create a context (wire an agent to a manifest artifact).

get.summary: List the workspace's contexts.
One context; the context's agent also gets the manifest source to run.

200.description: The context (with manifest source for the agent).

delete.summary: Delete a context (its creator or a workspace manager).

post.summary: Ask: open a session with the first question.

201.description: The new session and its first message.

get.summary: A context's sessions (owner sees all; others only their own).
One session with its transcript (asker or context owner).

200.description: The session, its context, and the full transcript.

patch.summary: Close a session (asker/owner) or fail it (the context's agent).

post.summary: Append a message to a session (asker follow-up or the agent's answer).

get.summary: The runner's queue: open sessions with transcripts (agent bearer).

200.description: Open sessions, oldest first, each with its transcript.

post.summary: Record a view of an artifact (de-duped; owner self-views excluded).

204.description: Recorded (or skipped as a dup / self-view / disabled).

get.summary: View stats for an artifact (collaborators only).

200.description: Totals, per-version + daily counts, and recent distinct viewers.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's recent notifications and unread count.

200.description: The 50 most recent notifications and the current unread count.

post.summary: Mark notifications read (all, or a set of ids); returns the new unread count.

get.summary: List the workspace's webhooks (Admin only).

200.description: The workspace's webhooks, without their signing secrets.

post.summary: Create a webhook (Admin only).

201.description: The created webhook, without its signing secret.

get.summary: Recent delivery attempts for a webhook (Admin only).

post.summary: Send a sample event to a webhook so you can confirm it lands (Admin only).

get.summary: List an artifact's subdomains + the workspace domains it's reachable at.

200.description: The subdomain base, the artifact's subdomains, and workspace domains.

put.summary: Claim a vanity subdomain for the artifact.

200.description: The subdomain (already claimed by this artifact).

delete.summary: Release one of the artifact's subdomains.

get.summary: List the workspace's custom domains and whether they're supported here.

200.description: Whether custom domains are enabled, the CNAME target, and the domains.

post.summary: Attach a custom domain to the workspace.

200.description: The domain (already attached to this workspace).

201.description: The newly attached domain, pending DNS validation.

post.summary: Re-check a custom domain's validation status.

delete.summary: Detach a custom domain from the workspace.
